Bionic Bay is a fantastic puzzle platformer that completely hooks you with its crazy physics and Fun swap mechanic. Instead of basic double-jumping, you instantly trade places with mid-air objects, turning falling boulders and deadly lasers into your own personal launching pads. It relies entirely on pure momentum, making every escape feel chaotic, rewarding, and unscripted. You will die constantly in its dark, hostile world, but the instant respawns keep the frustration low and the pacing fast. It is incredibly fun, and I highly recommend it if you want a challenging physics playground.
